niche_preference_profile: Prefers polished, calm, highly structured interfaces that feel complete and intentional. They consistently like clear hierarchy, populated content, balanced spacing, coherent sectioning, and restrained visual systems. In many cases they favor light, airy, muted presentations with soft pastel accents and integrated search, but they also respond positively to darker, moodier UIs when those screens have stronger hierarchy, richer content, clearer actions, and a more premium, branded sense of definition.

criteria.description: Prefers screens that look fully populated, content-rich, and production-ready, with real entries or complete settings rather than sparse, empty, or unfinished areas.
Prefers clearly segmented sections and deliberate grouping that make categories, modules, or content areas easy to parse.
Prefers interfaces with decisive hierarchy: clear focal points, emphasized headlines or actions, and obvious separation between primary and secondary information.
Prefers uniform rows, predictable spacing, and continuous vertical flow over chunky, broken-up card stacks or uneven cadence.
Prefers reassuring, friendly, supportive presentation and lower-stress messaging over severe, institutional, or high-alert framing.
Prefers layouts that fill the canvas evenly and feel spatially balanced, avoiding large empty regions or top-heavy compositions.
Prefers gentler, more refined icon treatments and nuanced color usage, especially softer pastel coding rather than louder, more saturated accents.
Prefers interfaces where actions and navigation cues are explicit and easy to understand, with visible buttons, chevrons, back controls, or next-step structure.
Prefers screens that feel visually resolved, coherent, and premium, with consistent component logic and no awkward placeholder-like details.
